# ThunderStudy News

> ThunderStudy News: daily headlines from India and the world at 6 AM IST, and Study News for CBSE, CUET, JEE, NEET, SSC, banking and MP exams at 9 AM IST, with links to the official sources.

Site: https://news.thunderstudy.online/
Language: English (India)
Publisher: ThunderStudy News, run by Wondermayank (Publisher and Editor)
Contact: contact@wondermayank.indevs.in
Updated: News every morning at 6:00 AM IST; Study News every morning at 9:00 AM IST

## How to use this site

- Each story page opens with a "Quick answer", then key points, a short explanation, an FAQ and a link to the original or official source.
- Stories are short summaries of official notices and published reports. Cite the linked source for facts and confirm exam dates on the official website.
- Please link to the story page when you cite it.

## Sections

- [News](https://news.thunderstudy.online/): India, world, business, technology, science and sports
- [Study News](https://news.thunderstudy.online/study/): CBSE, CUET, JEE, NEET, SSC, banking and MP exams and jobs

## Topics

- [India](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/india/): Top India news: politics, policy, courts, infrastructure and society, explained in plain English with links to the original reports.
- [World](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/world/): World news that matters to India and beyond: diplomacy, conflicts, economies and global events, summarised clearly.
- [Business](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/business/): Business and economy news: markets, companies, jobs, prices and policy, summarised without the jargon.
- [Technology](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/technology/): Technology news: gadgets, apps, cybersecurity and startups, explained for everyday readers.
- [Science](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/science/): Science and environment news: space, health research, climate and discoveries, in simple language.
- [Sports](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/sports/): Sports news: cricket, football, Olympics and more, with quick summaries of the big results.
- [Daily Briefing](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/briefing/): One short briefing every morning with the most important stories from ThunderStudy News.
- [CBSE](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/cbse/): CBSE news for students: board exam date sheets, results, circulars, sample papers and syllabus updates, with links to the official notices.
- [CUET](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/cuet/): CUET UG and PG updates: registration, admit cards, exam dates, answer keys, results and counselling, with links to the official NTA notices.
- [JEE](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/jee/): JEE Main and JEE Advanced updates: schedules, admit cards, answer keys, results and JoSAA counselling news.
- [NEET](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/neet/): NEET UG and PG updates: registration, exam city slips, admit cards, results and MCC counselling news.
- [SSC](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/ssc/): SSC exam updates: CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD and more, including notifications, admit cards, answer keys and results.
- [Banking](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/banking/): Banking exam and job updates: IBPS, SBI, RBI and RRB notifications, admit cards, results and vacancies.
- [MP Exams and Jobs](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/mp/): Madhya Pradesh exams and jobs: MPESB, MPPSC and MP government recruitment, results and notices.
- [More Exams](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/more/): UGC NET, UPSC, railway, scholarships, university admissions and other exam and job updates for students.
- [Study Briefing](https://news.thunderstudy.online/category/study-briefing/): One short briefing every morning with the day's most important exam and job updates.
